title: Requesting the ability to group wallpapers into albums from the wallpaper image plugin
line: The Image wallpaper picker can now group wallpapers into albums and show just one album at a time.
explanation: The Image wallpaper picker only showed one flat, alphabetical list of every wallpaper, with no way to group them by theme. A new WallpaperAlbums class in the image plugin keeps the albums in plasmarc, one [Wallpaper Albums][<generated id>] subgroup per album with its Name and Images (cleaned local paths), so any album name is safe; it is shared by every image wallpaper and follows changes made by other processes through KConfigWatcher. The C++ ImageFilterModel from bug 515292 gets an album property and does the album filtering alongside its system-wallpaper filter, and the QML adds an album menu to the Images header (All Images, each album, New Album…, Delete Album…) and an "Add to Album" hover button on each wallpaper with a checkable album list and New Album….

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: let users group wallpapers into albums

With many wallpapers it was hard to find the ones for a given theme, as
the picker only showed one long list. Each wallpaper now has an "Add to
Album" button, and the header can show all images or just one album.

BUG: 515293

media.caption: Master: the Image wallpaper picker has one flat list and no way to group wallpapers
With the change: the header's album menu lists All Images, the user's albums (here one named "Nature [2026] = trips"), New Album… and Delete Album…
Master: every wallpaper is always shown together
The "Nature [2026] = trips" album selected: only its two wallpapers are shown
Master: a wallpaper's hover buttons only offer Open Containing Folder
New "Add to Album" hover button: checkable list of albums the wallpaper is in, plus New Album…
